Onboarding.title: Create your organization
Onboarding.subtitle: Brands and channels live inside an organization. You can invite teammates later.
Onboarding.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
Onboarding.signedOutBody: This screen sets up your workspace once you are signed in. If someone invited you, register with exactly the address the invitation was sent to — any other address is refused.
Onboarding.invitedSubtitle: {inviter} invited you. Joining puts you in this organization's brands, channels and queue.
Onboarding.joinFailed: This invitation no longer works — it may already have been used, taken back, or expired. Ask whoever invited you for a new one.
Onboarding.invitationsUnchecked: Pubrick could not check whether anyone invited you: {reason}

Landing.title: Pubrick
Landing.tagline: The open-source AI content factory: it watches your sources, drafts on-brand content, waits for your approval, and publishes everywhere.

Brands.title: Brands
Brands.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
Brands.listError: Your brands could not be loaded, so this list is not the answer.
Brands.voiceHint: All three go into the model’s instructions on every generation, and nothing else tells it how this brand sounds. Leave one empty and it is left out of the prompt rather than guessed at.
Brands.voicePlaceholder: Dry and concrete. No exclamation marks, no hype.
Brands.audiencePlaceholder: Independent cafe owners who roast their own beans.
Brands.languageHint: The language code drafts are written in — for example en, es, ru or pt-BR.

Channels.title: Channels
Channels.testOk: OK — connected as {account}, can post to {target}
Channels.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
Channels.listError: This brand's channels could not be loaded, so this list is not the answer.
Channels.removeBody: Pubrick deletes the stored credentials for {channel} and cannot show them again — you would need new ones from the platform. Anything scheduled for it is cancelled and nothing is published to it afterwards, though posts it already published stay on the record. To replace a revoked token, use Edit instead.
Channels.editCredsHint: Leave these empty to keep the credentials already stored — Pubrick cannot show them again. Fill them in to replace them, which is how you install a new token after the platform revokes one. Scheduled posts stay scheduled and go out with the new credentials.
Channels.editCredsPartial: Fill in every credential field, or leave them all empty. New credentials replace the stored ones as a set, so a half-filled form would leave this channel unable to post.

Content.title: Queue
Content.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
Content.unknownOutcome: Sent to {channel}, but the platform never confirmed it. Check that channel before approving again — approving sends another copy.
Content.channelsUnavailable: Channel names could not be loaded, so channels are shown by ID.

ContentNew.title: New post
ContentNew.selectBrandFirst: Select a brand to see its channels.
ContentNew.noChannels: This brand has no channels yet.
ContentNew.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
ContentNew.briefPlaceholder: What should this post be about?
ContentNew.aiNotConfigured: Add an AI provider key to generate a post from a brief.
ContentNew.discardBody: Generating starts a new post from your brief. The text you typed here is not saved.

Publish.lensLegend: Dimmed sentences are still exactly what the AI wrote. Nothing dimmed means every sentence is yours. Deleting a sentence counts as your edit too, so the badge above can read Human-edited while everything left here is dimmed.
Publish.overridePlaceholder: Leave empty to use the item body above
Publish.alreadyPublished: This post has already been published; it can no longer be approved or rejected.
Publish.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

SettingsPage.title: Settings
SettingsPage.aiEmpty: No API key yet — add one below so Pubrick can generate content.
SettingsPage.aiRemoveBody: Pubrick deletes the stored {provider} key and cannot show it again — you would need a new one from {provider}. Content generation stops until a key is saved.
SettingsPage.aiCostAtLeast: ≥ {amount} ({count, plural, one {# call unpriced} other {# calls unpriced}})
SettingsPage.aiCostUnknown: cost not reported ({count, plural, one {# call} other {# calls}})
SettingsPage.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
SettingsPage.aiTestFailInvalidKey: The provider rejected this API key.
SettingsPage.aiTestFailModelNotFound: The provider does not recognise this model id.
SettingsPage.aiTestFailNoStructuredOutput: The model answered, but could not return the structured output Pubrick needs. Try another model.
SettingsPage.aiTestFailRateLimited: The provider is rate-limiting or temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
SettingsPage.aiTestFailRefused: The provider refused the request. Check the key and the model id.
SettingsPage.aiTestFailTimedOut: The model call ran out of time before the provider answered. Try again, or check the model id.
SettingsPage.aiTestFailTooManyTests: This workspace has used its {limit} test calls for the past hour. Each Test is a paid call to your provider, so they are capped. Try again later.
SettingsPage.aiTestFailUnreadableKey: The stored key could not be read. Save it again.
SettingsPage.aiSpendError: Spend so far could not be loaded — this is not a total of zero.
SettingsPage.peopleInviteBody: Pubrick sends no email. You get a link to pass on yourself, and the person has to register with exactly this address — the sign-up gate lets through no other.
SettingsPage.peopleInviteLinkHint: Send this link to {email}. It works once, only for that address, and expires {expires}. Pubrick cannot show it again — inviting the same address later replaces this invitation with a new link.
SettingsPage.peopleRevokeBody: The link sent to {email} stops working and that address can no longer register here. You can invite them again afterwards.
SettingsPage.peopleInviteFailMember: That address is already a member of this organization.
SettingsPage.peopleInviteFailEmail: That is not a valid email address.
SettingsPage.peopleInviteFailLimit: This organization has too many invitations waiting. Remove one before sending another.

Language.title: Language
Language.confirmBody: Switching language reloads this screen, and the text you have typed here has not been saved yet.

Runs.title: Generation
Runs.noBrief: No brief — drafted from the source.
Runs.claimsEmpty: No factual claims were listed for this draft.

failure.cancelled: The model call was cancelled before it finished.
failure.every_channel_deleted: Every channel this run was started for has since been deleted. Add a channel and try again.
failure.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
failure.invalid_key: The provider rejected the API key. Check it in Settings.
failure.model_not_found: The provider does not recognise the model id set in Settings.
failure.no_api_key: No AI provider key is configured. Add one in Settings, then try again.
failure.no_structured_output: The model could not return the structured output Pubrick needs. Try another model.
failure.provider_refused: The provider refused the request. Check the key and the model id in Settings.
failure.rate_limited: The provider is rate-limiting or temporarily unavailable. This run will be retried.
failure.retries_exhausted: This run was retried until its attempts ran out. Try again.
failure.timed_out: The model call ran out of time before the provider answered. This run will be retried.
failure.too_long_for_channel: The model could not fit one of the channels' length limits. Try a shorter brief.
failure.unreadable_key: The stored API key could not be read. Save it again in Settings.

Runs.draftDeleted: This run's draft has been deleted.
Runs.unrecordedCalls: {count, plural, one {# model call on this run was billed but could not be recorded} other {# model calls on this run were billed but could not be recorded}} — the spend figure in Settings counts {count, plural, one {this call} other {these calls}} among the calls it cannot price.
Runs.unrecordedUnknown: This run predates the counting of model calls the ledger could not record, so whether every call on it was recorded is not known.
Runs.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

Errors.content_not_found: This post no longer exists — it may have been deleted.
Errors.adaptation_not_found: This channel's own text no longer exists — the channel may have been deleted.
Errors.content_pinned_approved: An approved post cannot be edited. Reject it first.
Errors.content_pinned_published: This post has already been published and can no longer be edited.
Errors.adaptation_pinned_scheduled: A scheduled post cannot be edited. Reject the post first.
Errors.adaptation_pinned_queued: This post is already queued for publishing and cannot be edited. Reject it first.
Errors.adaptation_pinned_publishing: This post is being published right now and cannot be edited. Reject it first.
Errors.adaptation_pinned_published: This channel's post has already been published and can no longer be edited.
Errors.content_already_published: This post has already been published; it can no longer be approved or rejected.
Errors.content_no_channels_left: This post has no channels left to publish to — every channel it was written for has been deleted.
Errors.unread_ai_draft: No one has read this AI-written draft yet. Open it, or edit it, before approving.
Errors.unread_ai_draft_open_only: No one has read the AI-written text in this post yet. Open it before approving — editing the text cannot clear this, because no complete AI version of it was ever recorded.
Errors.schedule_in_past: Pick a time in the future to schedule this post.
Errors.schedule_already_queued: This post is already queued for publishing, so its time cannot be changed. Reject it to stop the delivery, then approve it again with the time you want.
Errors.schedule_already_publishing: This post is being sent to one of its channels right now, so its time cannot be changed. Wait for that delivery to finish, then decide from what it reports.
Errors.refine_limit_reached: You've used all {limit} model calls available this hour. Wait a little, then ask for another suggestion.
Errors.refine_needs_ai_draft: The refine verbs work on a draft the model wrote, and this post was written by hand.
Errors.refine_no_credential: No AI provider key is stored yet. Add one in Settings, then try again.
Errors.refine_timed_out: The model did not answer in time. Nothing was changed — ask again.
Errors.refine_failed: The model could not revise this selection. Nothing was changed. If it keeps happening, test your API key in Settings.
Errors.refine_too_long: This suggestion would make the post too long. Shorten the post, or select less of it.
Errors.refine_proposal_not_found: That suggestion is no longer available — it was accepted, discarded, or replaced by a newer one.
Errors.refine_would_launder: Accepting this would credit the model with words you wrote. Select the whole sentence, then ask again.
Errors.refine_anchor_lost: The text this suggestion was written for is no longer in the post. Select it again and ask for a new suggestion.
Errors.channels_not_in_brand: One or more of the chosen channels do not belong to this brand. Reload the page and pick them again.
Errors.channel_not_found: This channel no longer exists — it may have been deleted.
Errors.unreadable_credentials: Pubrick can no longer read this channel's stored credentials — this instance's encryption key has changed. Use Edit to save them again.
Errors.brand_not_found: This brand no longer exists — it may have been deleted.
Errors.brand_has_no_channels: This brand has no channels yet. Add one before generating.
Errors.run_limit_reached: You already have {limit} generations queued or running. Wait for one to finish, or cancel it.
Errors.run_not_cancellable_succeeded: This generation has already finished; its draft is ready.
Errors.run_not_cancellable_failed: This generation has already failed; there is nothing left to cancel.
Errors.run_not_cancellable_cancelled: This generation has already been cancelled.
Errors.run_not_dismissable_queued: A queued generation cannot be dismissed. Cancel it first.
Errors.run_not_dismissable_running: A running generation cannot be dismissed. Cancel it first.
Errors.ai_credential_not_found: No API key is stored for this provider. Save one first.
Errors.invalid_request: Some of what you entered is not valid. Check the form and try again.
Errors.signed_out: You're signed out. Log in again to continue.
Errors.no_active_organization: No active organization — create or select one first.
Errors.forbidden: You don't have access to this.
